title: Orchestrated hate campaign against AI.
author: Rsouss
selftext: This time, the target is the AI ​​Tribo. It seems the artists still don't understand what's happening; large companies like Adobe aren't immune to having their artists' images copied.

comments.author: mike_hoff
comments.body: What’s the hate campaign? Someone used some else’s assets without credit …

replies.author: Rsouss
replies.body: Everyone has their own version of events; who's telling the truth? Following that, there's another post with the same premise: who believes them knowing they hate AI?

replies.author: -svde-
replies.body: everyone has their own perspective, some completely ignorant and biased. versions of events don't mean there's more than one truth. you need confirmation bias so you're stretching like crazy for it

replies.author: mike_hoff
replies.body: What are you even talking about?

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: umm, it is an option... free tier models are public models by default. I don't know what the fine prints say but public models are probably just "public"... (not that I would randomly download someone's generated model and put it in a game... that just seem iffy when I can just generate my own using whatever)

replies.author: friggleriggle
replies.body: That's not the contention.  The artist claims they made this exact scene without AI and put it online for sale as an asset.  And then Tripo posted it claiming it was generated with their AI.

that doesn't seem like a likely scenario but tripo does have all kinds of reputations so

if I was running things as tripo, I would just pull something from the gallery. (or hire some 3d artists to fake it if it comes to that)

so what is the verdict now? does the artist have proof? does tripo have proof?

replies.body:
I don't know any details just communicate what the claim is.

Who knows could have been an intern at Tripo thinking it was AI generated and making a post they shouldn't have 🤷‍♂️

replies.body:
but anything from their gallery is basically their generated models. if the artist uploaded his own work as input (for ai editing?) then it is still easily provable

replies.author: -svde-
replies.body:
what is wrong with you lol. if you are unable to look at the facts of a situation in front of you, when they are this blatant, then you don't have principles, you are just blindly trying to shit on people you see as opposition and supporting a company just because they have ai in their name or marketing copy. do you think this is any better than antis who spew hate at everything with ai in it no matter the context?

[https://x.com/OsbmentRhett/status/2110800617321181422](https://x.com/OsbmentRhett/status/2110800617321181422)

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
huh? I was asking the other person what the situation is... I wasn't making any assumptions about it since I didn't really look into it myself.

okay, so this is already proven i.e. tripo basically have astra using a premade asset made by someone else without attribution (the video claims "astra put it together" but it is more like "astra downloaded it")

I didnt check the fab link but I assume the artist is saying "this scene asset is his" and it checked out, right?

then how is it a hate campaign if it is justified? is OP shilling for tripo then?

replies.author: -svde-
replies.body:
sorry if that's the case, but can you see from your previous replies how that might be interpreted differently?

even if you didn't bother looking at the links for yourself. both posts in OP's screenshot clearly state that tripo is falsely advertising their platform (using art they claim was generated via astra) with non AI-generated assets

first you said that free tier models are public by default, which ofc isn't relevant but that's understandable if you didn't read the post you were responding to. 

then someone flat out told you what i just said above, and you said "that doesn't seem like a likely scenario" despite clearly knowing that tripo has a bad rep in the scene. and then reiterated that the artist must've generated a private model. again, despite being clearly told the artist wasn't using AI and didn't use their platform.

then you *again* reiterated that "anything from their gallery is basically their generated models" and that the artist simply must have uploaded it to tripo for "input (for ai editing?)"

and finally "I dont see a "coincidence" scenario here. one side would be lying most likely..." 

well, yeah. tripo is lying. this was stated from the start. they took someone's non-ai, not-uploaded-to-their-platform asset pack, gave it to astra, and had it "make" the environment. and no, the vid didn't say astra "put it together", it said "astra built this entire zelda-style environment for me in 10 min" when astra didn't build shit, it just implemented the stolen environment assets into a playable scene using Unreal Engine. 

you have had multiple opportunities to verify this information, which has been given directly to you, in plain english, multiple times. i explicitly explained it, linked to it, clarified it? people lie all the time about shit, can you maybe understand why it's so aggravating when people try to spread blatant msinformation or remain purposefully obtuse? and if you're not doing that, then why would you act surprised when someone responds like this when you've been politely informed of the facts 4-5 times? and you're somehow still asking me if it checked out? cmon man, you took the effort to baselessly defend tripo, you can't open a link?

yeah it's not a hate campaign, OP is just trying to spread misinfo about antis, or rather about people whose work is being stolen who you don't even know what their feelings are on AI necessarily.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
I literally was asking questions and I used "if" this, "if" that...

my point was that 1) I dont think it is a likely scenario for a normal company but 2) tripo is tripo... so it is a 50/50 (without knowing more about the story)

I ask the other person but the other person described the event while trying to stay very neutral for some reasons

"why it's so aggravating when people try to spread blatant msinformation or remain purposefully obtuse?"

bro, calm down. it was a just a casual reddit comment thread. nobody else is probably reading this. People don't read nested comments all that much.

I mean, yes, I was too lazy to open a link. hence the back and forth with the other person.

if OP is spreading misinformation, shouldn't you just come after him directly?

to your last point, it is a paid asset. While it is obviously a scummy thing to do to misrepresent someone else's work, I don't know about the actual "stealing" i.e. the artist probably did get paid.

there is also the bit where some asset artists dont consent their asset to AI use.

for the record, I usually provide attributions properly and all that. I dont condone these type of dishonesty if it is not clear.
